pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: A mentor teacher shall be assigned, except in rare circumstances where it is not practical to do so.

pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: Selection of positions, such as department head, pro-ed facilitator, site-based coach and any other position for which a stipend is paid, shall be based upon criteria and a time frame established at the school level between the principal and the faculty, department or team affected.
